fruits.extendedStory: The cathedral is built in the Gothic style. That means pointed arches, and windows that reach upward rather than across. Work began in 1196 and carried on for generations of masons. The finished building stands 77 metres tall. Its front looks out over Piazza Jacopo della Quercia, a short walk from the great tower.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Die Kathedrale ist gotisch gebaut. Das heißt: spitze Bögen und Fenster, die eher nach oben streben als in die Breite. Angefangen wurde 1196, und gebaut wurde über Generationen hinweg. Am Ende stand ein Bau von 77 Metern Höhe. Seine Front schaut auf die Piazza Jacopo della Quercia.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The cathedral is built in the Gothic style. That means pointed arches, and windows that reach upward rather than across. Work began in 1196 and carried on for generations of masons. The finished building stands 77 metres tall. Its front looks out over Piazza Jacopo della Quercia, a short walk from the great tower.

localizedStory.de: Sienas Kathedrale wurde 1196 begonnen und ragt 77 Meter über den Platz.
localizedStory.en: Siena's cathedral was begun in 1196 and rises 77 metres above the square.

fruits.name: Cattedrale di Santa Maria Assunta
fruits.story: Siena's cathedral was begun in 1196 and rises 77 metres above the square.

fruits.extendedStory: Stand on Via di Salicotto and tip your head back. The work here got going in 1338, and nobody walked in until 1348. That is a long wait for one building. The builders kept at it season after season while the city went about its business below. Today you can put a hand on the base and look all the way up.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Turm wuchs im mittelalterlichen Stil, so wie Siena in jenen Jahrzehnten baute. Zwischen Baubeginn und Eröffnung lag ein langer Weg, und die Stadt blieb dran. Steh unten an der Via di Salicotto und lass den Blick die Dächer entlanglaufen. Die Kathedrale erhebt sich nur ein kurzes Stück weiter.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Stand on Via di Salicotto and tip your head back. The work here got going in 1338, and nobody walked in until 1348. That is a long wait for one building. The builders kept at it season after season while the city went about its business below. Today you can put a hand on the base and look all the way up.

localizedStory.de: Der Bau dieses Turms begann 1338, eröffnet wurde er 1348. Seither wacht er über Siena.
localizedStory.en: Work on this tower began in 1338, and it opened in 1348. It has watched over Siena ever since.

fruits.name: Torre del Mangia
fruits.story: Work on this tower began in 1338, and it opened in 1348. It has watched over Siena ever since.

fruits.extendedStory: The square has changed its name more than once. It was Poggio dei Malavolti, then piazza Umberto I, before it took the name it wears now. Two buildings frame it today. The architect Vittorio Mariani drew them both: the chamber of commerce of 1904 and the post office of 1912. In a few years one hand gave the whole square its face.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Platz hat seinen Namen mehr als einmal gewechselt. Erst hieß er Poggio dei Malavolti, dann piazza Umberto I. Zwei Häuser rahmen ihn heute ein. Beide entwarf der Architekt Vittorio Mariani: die Handelskammer von 1904 und das Postamt von 1912. Mariani prägte damit in wenigen Jahren das ganze Gesicht des Platzes.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The square has changed its name more than once. It was Poggio dei Malavolti, then piazza Umberto I, before it took the name it wears now. Two buildings frame it today. The architect Vittorio Mariani drew them both: the chamber of commerce of 1904 and the post office of 1912. In a few years one hand gave the whole square its face.

localizedStory.de: Die Sienesen nennen diesen Platz piazza della Posta, nach dem Postamt an seiner Seite.
localizedStory.en: Sienese call this square piazza della Posta, after the post office standing on it.

fruits.name: Piazza Giacomo Matteotti
fruits.story: Sienese call this square piazza della Posta, after the post office standing on it.

fruits.extendedStory: Siena measured its wall in braccia, an old unit. The ring came to 11,600 of them, about seven kilometres in today's units. After 1348 it never grew again. The plague reached the city that year and Siena lost a great many people. Nobody needed more room behind the wall after that. The line they stopped at is the one you walk today.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Siena maß seine Mauer in braccia, einer alten Einheit. Der Ring kam auf 11.600 davon, nach heutigem Maß etwa sieben Kilometer. Ab 1348 wuchs er nicht mehr weiter. In jenem Jahr kam die Pest in die Stadt, und Siena verlor sehr viele Menschen. Danach brauchte niemand mehr Platz hinter der Mauer. Die Linie, an der sie damals aufhörten, gehst du heute ab.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Siena measured its wall in braccia, an old unit. The ring came to 11,600 of them, about seven kilometres in today's units. After 1348 it never grew again. The plague reached the city that year and Siena lost a great many people. Nobody needed more room behind the wall after that. The line they stopped at is the one you walk today.

localizedStory.de: Acht Haupttore öffnen sich in dieser Mauer, und der ganze Ring misst rund sieben Kilometer um die Altstadt.
localizedStory.en: Eight main gates open in this wall, and the whole ring runs about seven kilometres around the Old Town.

fruits.name: Mura di Siena
fruits.story: Eight main gates open in this wall, and the whole ring runs about seven kilometres around the Old Town.

fruits.extendedStory: The wall got two gates here at nearly the same time, this one and Porta Tufi. Sienese know it by a second name as well, the Porta delle Maremme. In the 16th century Baldassarre Peruzzi strengthened it, long after it was built. Walk up from Via San Marco and you pass through both building ages at once.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Die Mauer bekam hier zwei Tore fast gleichzeitig, dieses und die Porta Tufi. Die Sienesen kennen es unter einem zweiten Namen, Porta delle Maremme. Im 16. Jahrhundert verstärkte Baldassarre Peruzzi das Tor. Wer heute von der Via San Marco heraufkommt, geht durch beide Bauzeiten auf einmal.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The wall got two gates here at nearly the same time, this one and Porta Tufi. Sienese know it by a second name as well, the Porta delle Maremme. In the 16th century Baldassarre Peruzzi strengthened it, long after it was built. Walk up from Via San Marco and you pass through both building ages at once.

localizedStory.de: Dieses Tor trägt einen zweiten Namen: Porta delle Maremme. Geöffnet wurde es 1325.
localizedStory.en: This gate carries a second name, the Porta delle Maremme. It was opened in the wall in 1325.

fruits.name: Porta San Marco
fruits.story: This gate carries a second name, the Porta delle Maremme. It was opened in the wall in 1325.

fruits.extendedStory: Three religious orders held this church in turn. Benedictine monks of the Silvestrine branch had it at the start, then the Vallombrosans. Around the middle of the 15th century the Dominican friars took over. Between 1498 and 1530 they rebuilt the church almost completely. The square in front has carried its name ever since.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Drei Orden hatten diese Kirche nacheinander in der Hand. Zuerst kamen Benediktinermönche der Silvestriner, dann die Vallombrosaner. Um die Mitte des 15. Jahrhunderts übernahmen die Dominikaner. Zwischen 1498 und 1530 bauten sie die Kirche fast vollständig neu. Der Platz davor trägt ihren Namen bis heute.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Three religious orders held this church in turn. Benedictine monks of the Silvestrine branch had it at the start, then the Vallombrosans. Around the middle of the 15th century the Dominican friars took over. Between 1498 and 1530 they rebuilt the church almost completely. The square in front has carried its name ever since.

localizedStory.de: Der Platz trägt den Namen seiner Kirche, die Dominikaner zwischen 1498 und 1530 neu bauten.
localizedStory.en: The square is named for its church, which Dominican friars rebuilt between 1498 and 1530.

fruits.name: Piazza Santo Spirito
fruits.story: The square is named for its church, which Dominican friars rebuilt between 1498 and 1530.

fruits.extendedStory: Before 1954 the traders laid out their goods in Piazza del Mercato, right behind the town hall. That square had an older trade before them. It was the foro boario, the city's cattle market. Anyone after a cow went there to haggle. Then the stalls moved up to this avenue, and here they stayed.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Vor 1954 breiteten die Händler ihre Waren auf der Piazza del Mercato aus, gleich hinter dem Rathaus. Dieser Platz hatte davor ein noch älteres Geschäft. Dort stand der foro boario, der Viehmarkt der Stadt. Wer Rinder kaufen wollte, ging dorthin. Dann zogen die Stände herauf an diese Allee und blieben.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Before 1954 the traders laid out their goods in Piazza del Mercato, right behind the town hall. That square had an older trade before them. It was the foro boario, the city's cattle market. Anyone after a cow went there to haggle. Then the stalls moved up to this avenue, and here they stayed.

localizedStory.de: Sienas Straßenmarkt zog 1954 hierher an die Allee, weg vom alten Platz hinter dem Rathaus.
localizedStory.en: Siena's street market moved up to this avenue in 1954, out of the old square behind the town hall.

fruits.name: Mercato delle Merci
fruits.story: Siena's street market moved up to this avenue in 1954, out of the old square behind the town hall.

fruits.extendedStory: The church on this square keeps two big pieces of painted wall. They once hung outdoors on the city gates. One came off Porta Romana, the other off Porta dei Pispini. The building itself had a long run of bad luck. Fire tore through it in 1655 and it stayed battered for more than two centuries.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Die Kirche an diesem Platz bewahrt zwei große Stücke bemalter Wand. Sie hingen einmal draußen an den Stadttoren. Eines kam von der Porta Romana, das andere von der Porta dei Pispini. Dem Bau selbst erging es lange schlecht. Das Feuer von 1655 richtete ihn übel zu, und über zwei Jahrhunderte blieb er so.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The church on this square keeps two big pieces of painted wall. They once hung outdoors on the city gates. One came off Porta Romana, the other off Porta dei Pispini. The building itself had a long run of bad luck. Fire tore through it in 1655 and it stayed battered for more than two centuries.

localizedStory.de: Ein Brand von 1655 ließ die Kirche an diesem Platz über zweihundert Jahre lang beschädigt zurück.
localizedStory.en: A fire in 1655 left the church on this square in a poor state for more than two hundred years.

fruits.name: Piazza San Francesco
fruits.story: A fire in 1655 left the church on this square in a poor state for more than two hundred years.

localizedStory.de: 1325 mit dem letzten Mauerring der Stadt gebaut und Agnolo di Ventura zugeschrieben.
localizedStory.en: Built in 1325 with the city's last ring of walls, and credited to Agnolo di Ventura.

fruits.name: Porta Tufi
fruits.story: Built in 1325 with the city's last ring of walls, and credited to Agnolo di Ventura.

fruits.extendedStory: Two men are named for this gate: Agnolo di Ventura and Agostino di Giovanni, who raised it in 1327. Look up inside the arch and you will find the wall bare. The paint that once covered it went indoors long ago. What is left is the stonework those two set, and it is the part that never moved.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Agnolo di Ventura und Agostino di Giovanni errichteten dieses Tor 1327. Hoch im Bogen malte später jemand die Krönung Mariens. Dort blieb das Bild sehr lange, mitten im Wetter. 1978 hob man es von der Wand und trug es in die Basilica di San Francesco. Seither hängt es dort im Trockenen.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Two men are named for this gate: Agnolo di Ventura and Agostino di Giovanni, who raised it in 1327. Look up inside the arch and you will find the wall bare. The paint that once covered it went indoors long ago. What is left is the stonework those two set, and it is the part that never moved.

localizedStory.de: Ein Bild der Madonna füllte einst diesen Torbogen. 1978 wurde es abgenommen und nach San Francesco gebracht.
localizedStory.en: A painting of the Virgin once filled this archway. In 1978 it came down and moved into San Francesco.

fruits.name: Porta Romana
fruits.story: A painting of the Virgin once filled this archway. In 1978 it came down and moved into San Francesco.
